title: Kok-Nar language — Grokipedia
text: Kok-Nar, also known as Kok Narr or Gundara, is an extinct Australian Aboriginal language of the Pama-Nyungan family, specifically within the Norman Pama subgroup.

title: Kok-Nar language Facts for Kids
text: Kok-Nar (also called Kok Narr or Gundara) was an Indigenous Australian language.The Kok-Nar language was part of a large group of languages. These languages are known as the Pama-Nyungan language family. This family includes many Indigenous languages from Australia.
